acceptanceCriteria: doctor reports RUNNABLE-HELD-IDLE for a ticket whose work state names runnable work needing a pool member (queued batch or final run), excluded by an admission or focus rule, while the matching pool has free members for N ticks; it names the ticket, the excluding rule, the age of the work and the free members.

An optional policy lets run-only stages (no author session) bypass author-capacity admission when members are free; with it on, the work dispatches to a free member without entering the author window.
No finding when no member is free or the work needs an author session; fixture tests for each; Closes #1181.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1181. Runnable batches (including a final qualification whose obligations were all witnessed) sat queued >10 days behind focus/priority/author-capacity admission rules while 3 of 4 pool members were idle.
title: GH #1181: doctor RUNNABLE-HELD-IDLE - run-only work held by an admission/focus rule while pool members are free
